scope: Independent read-only source review of six interface coverage specifications and all 21 synthetic examples. Wrote only this private report; no source edits, builds, browser runs or Home Assistant operations.

files.notes: Read full guide: four native view layouts, containers versus views, generated/filtered membership, capability-owned feature choices, badges and header/footer limits. Examples preserve reported values, partial-day meaning and no all-clear from an empty filter. The specimen grid class is now corrected to the supported local component.

Read full guide: current/period readings, domain-dependent rows, header/group eligibility, attribute units and missing values, More info and default fallbacks remain distinct. Corrected pinned source link now matches the stated frontend commit.

Read full guide: decorative/live/retained imagery, equivalent normal-flow information, action gestures versus semantics, escaped authored content and blocked external embeds are covered. Local and external Webpage sources are now both acknowledged.

Read full guide: helpers versus device commands, real bounds/options, counter reset, remote feedback, draft/save/report separation and permissions are sound. Acceptance now explicitly preserves native automation consequences of real creation/saving.

Read full guide: resource types and IDs, provider privacy, scalar/structured data, presentation/internal selector boundaries, errors and typed round trips remain distinct. The examples explicitly avoid claiming to implement a live searchable native selector or YAML parser.

Read full guide: configured plant thresholds, environmental units, sun calculation, event timestamps, retained image evidence and generated output remain distinct. The examples make no diagnosis, safe-room verdict or automatic action claim.
Read all 21 complete HTML records and metadata, including all linked destination IDs and original illustration provenance.

examples.notes: Named unavailable reading has recovery context; separate room links lead to existing complete specimens. Grid class now uses the supported local grid; no device action occurs.
Zero matches and one unavailable contact do not claim all windows closed; criteria, configured denominator and report time are explicit.
Reported heat mode, measured temperature and target stay separate from the local Heat/Off draft. Native capability limits are stated.
4.2 kWh has a partial-day interval and GMT/Europe-London context. Locked is a reported read-only state rather than an Unlock action.
Zero power, unavailable temperature, current reading and completed-day mean remain distinct with appropriate units/periods.
Scene operation is separate from a lamp state; explicit local preview changes only feedback and does not imply all members reached settings.
Absent title does not make playback unavailable; volume is 35%, and last changed is not falsely presented as a heartbeat.
Original schematic has accurate alternative text, provenance and declared non-live status. Normal-flow named readings and a real detail destination remain available.
Image failure preserves entity/state/temperature/timestamp and is not conflated with a device or camera connection failure.
Authored heating task guidance separates measurement from target and links to a complete local target specimen.
External fallback names home-assistant.io, uses its verified official documentation URL and does not actually embed or fetch an external frame.
Helper preference is stored configuration rather than a current measurement; native numeric bounds/step/required label are explicit. Local form saves and commands nothing.
Removed saved option remains visible and unresolved; replacement initially empty and required. Existing dependencies must be reviewed before a real save.
Counter reset to 2 is distinct from decrementing or stock measurement. Static review offers no pretend reset operation.
Entity identifier and voice resources are separate; unknown provider location prevents a false local-processing claim. Summary explicitly is not a working selector.
Duration minutes and Europe/London clock time have distinct labels and schemas; no claim the clock input stores a duration.
Labelled retained structured text checks only non-empty input and explicitly does not parse YAML, validate the HA schema or execute actions.
18% is compared to an explicitly invented 20% household threshold, while missing light is not zero and no plant diagnosis is offered.
720 ppm remains a measured quantity without an invented health/safety verdict; sun elevation is described as calculated, not measured brightness.
Single-press timestamp is an event, not a duration, person identity or continuing presence; retained-image timing is explained.
Generated suggestion is labelled unverified and cannot establish a missing contact state; reported light evidence and no-action scope are explicit.

source_checks.local_example_destinations: All referenced ../examples/ IDs resolve in existing example YAML sources; rendered asset/link checking was not run.
source_checks.safe_forms: All interactive forms use the existing data-demo-form protocol. docs/config.rb normalises fields/buttons to disabled when JavaScript is unavailable, while example.js prevents submission and gives local-only feedback. No request/backend handler is added by these specimens.
source_checks.styling: All custom classes now resolve in example.css.scss. GOV.UK classes rely on the existing imported frontend bundle. Original schematic SVG was read and matches its alternative text; no rendered layout/contrast assertion is made.

findings.title: Pinned More info source link had a malformed commit
findings.observed: Initial reviewed link used e32bc0696ebef323… instead of e32bc0696ebefde323….
findings.resolution: Parent corrected the link while review was in progress. Current source uses e32bc0696ebefde323f5b791269ad0c57f3f99d9 consistently.
findings.acceptance: Keep the correct immutable commit and file path; final source/link verification remains parent-owned.

findings.title: Composition specimen uses an undefined grid class
findings.impact: The intended room-card grid has no stylesheet rule, so this particular composition example silently falls back to a normal block flow.
findings.proposal: Reuse the existing civica-card-demo-grid class with appropriate children rather than introduce a parallel class.
findings.acceptance: Confirm the rendered specimen uses the supported responsive grid at wider widths and wraps at 320px/200% text without changing its labels or destinations.
findings.resolution: Owner replaced the undefined class with the supported civica-card-demo-grid. Source verified; responsive rendering remains pending.

findings.title: Helper creation acceptance promises an unsupported absence of automation effects

evidence.excerpt: Verify that creating or viewing a helper does not run its dependent automation.

findings.impact: The no-effect guarantee is appropriate to viewing/editing a local draft, but actual helper creation or saved state publication can participate in native state/event automation triggers. Requiring suppression would contradict the guide’s own native-owned semantics.
findings.proposal: Require opening a helper or editing an unsubmitted draft to dispatch no action. State that real creation or saved value changes retain native state/event consequences and dependent automation behaviour.
findings.acceptance: Copy clearly separates viewing/draft editing from committing creation/value changes; no blanket guarantee that actual creation/saving cannot run an automation.
findings.resolution: Owner now limits no-action acceptance to opening/editing an unsaved draft and explicitly preserves native automation consequences when creating/saving. Exact revised paragraph re-read.

findings.title: Webpage description excludes supported local content

evidence.excerpt: A Webpage card embeds another origin.

findings.impact: Native Webpage cards also support files served from /local. The absolute origin claim is factually too narrow for a comprehensive component mapping.
findings.proposal: Explain that Webpage can embed external content or a local file; apply provider/privacy/leave-HA wording specifically to external destinations and retain native sandbox/security settings for either source.
findings.acceptance: Guide acknowledges /local files without treating local origin as proof of trust, accessibility or unrestricted embedding.
findings.resolution: Owner now explicitly includes an external origin or local /local file. External destination wording and native security limits remain conditional to their applicable source.

sources_reviewed.supports: Helpers publish states which can be used in automation triggers; configured bounds, step and box/slider presentation remain native.
State triggers react to state changes, with explicit from/to filtering and attribute-only semantics.
Webpage supports both external webpages and /local files; browser and native sandbox limitations remain relevant.

not_claimed: No browser rendering, keyboard run, screen-reader test or live installation check was performed.
The finite registry mapping establishes design ownership, not proof that every integration or capability has been implemented or tested.
No screenshot/computed-style/contrast result is inferred from source inspection.
overall: Six substantive native-owned family specifications and 21 complete, bounded examples have been read. All four bounded review findings were corrected by the owners during review and their exact source changes re-read. No unresolved source finding remains. Rendered/build/browser/live acceptance is not claimed.
